Page.ComingSoon: This page comes in the next step. Until then, hotkeys can be changed in Settings (classic) in the tray menu. The other settings are in settings.json in the data folder: quit SLiveTranslator before you edit it and start it again afterwards. The app reads the file only when it starts, and writes over changes made to it while it runs.
Home.Title: Home
Home.SubtitlesHint: Reads the subtitle region and shows the translation over the game.
Home.GoogleBlocked: Google Translate: blocked on this network until {0}; MyMemory translates meanwhile
Home.RecommendTitle: For more free translation, in this order:
Home.Recommend.Email: Add an email for MyMemory (50,000 characters a day instead of 5,000).
Home.Recommend.Gemini: Add a Gemini API key: Gemini has a free tier.
Home.Recommend.DeepL: Add a DeepL API Free key (500,000 characters a month).
Home.Recommend.Claude: For the best names, pronouns and idioms: a Claude API key (paid).
Translation.Title: Translation
Translation.ProviderHint: The free services stay behind the one chosen here and translate whenever it cannot.
Translation.FreeAbout: No key needed. Google is tried first; when it blocks this network, MyMemory translates. Each line is translated alone, so names and pronouns can vary; an API key gives better translations.
Translation.CardsHint: Enter and check any service's key here, before or after picking the service above. A saved key is checked when its card is open.
Translation.UseContextHint: AI services translate a line better when they see the conversation before it.
Translation.EmailHint: Optional: raises MyMemory's free limit from 5,000 to 50,000 characters a day.
Translation.TestHint: Translates this line now with the settings on this page, saved or not. It is a real request and counts toward the service's quota.
Card.KeySaved: Saved. Type a new key to replace it.
Card.KeyUnreadable: The saved key cannot be read on this Windows account. Enter it again.
Card.KeyRemoved: The saved key is removed when you save. Type a key to keep one.
Card.Hint.NeedKey: Enter the API key and press Check.
Card.Hint.NeedAddress: Enter the server address and press Check.
Card.Hint.PressCheck: Press Check, or wait a moment: the list fills in once the key is checked.
Card.Hint.NoModels: This key lists no model that can translate.
Card.SavedModelMissing: The saved model {0} is not on this key's list. It stays selected until you pick another one.
Card.OfflineSavedModel: The saved model {0} will still be used.
Card.EffortHint: Low answers fastest; Medium thinks a little longer about hard lines and costs a little more.
Card.GeminiFreeTier: Gemini has a free tier: a key from Google AI Studio works without payment, within its daily limits. Google may use what is sent on the free tier to improve its products.

Subtitles.Title: Subtitles
Subtitles.RegionHint: Select only the strip where the subtitles appear, not the whole screen. The region is saved right away.
Subtitles.IntervalHint: How often the region is read. Lower reacts faster and uses more CPU.
Subtitles.Pause: Pause while the game is not in front
Subtitles.PauseHint: Reads nothing while you are in another window.
Subtitles.OcrModeHint: Automatic tries both ways and keeps the better reading.
Subtitles.LowImpactHint: Reads at a lower priority, so the game keeps more of the CPU.
Subtitles.GapRatioHint: In line heights (0.7 to 2.5). Raise it if sentences of one subtitle come out split.
Overlay.Title: Overlay
Overlay.PreviewHint: Shows a sample subtitle with the settings on this page for a few seconds, saved or not.
Overlay.MaxLinesHint: How many of the latest lines stay in the box, so a line that went by fast can still be read.
Overlay.ShowOriginalHint: Shows the game's text, smaller, under each translation.
Overlay.LabelSecondsHint: How long the labels of translate screen stay; 0 keeps them until cleared.
Overlay.Sample2: We should find shelter before nightfall.
Overlay.Sample3: Roach is tired, and so am I.
